title: PR Diff Statistics for Risk Classification
description: Input statistics describing a pull-request diff, used by the PR audit router to classify risk level.

files_changed.description: Number of files changed in the PR.

lines_added.description: Total lines added across all changed files.

lines_deleted.description: Total lines deleted across all changed files.

touches_schema.description: True when the PR modifies schema files (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, protobuf, SQL DDL, etc.).

touches_migration.description: True when the PR contains database or data-format migration files.

touches_secrets_config.description: True when the PR modifies secrets, credential, or sensitive configuration files.
